requirement.title: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
requirement.text:
#### Bug description

The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true. This has happened since version 3.1.1. It still worked in 3.1.0.

story: The change stops the type collector from crashing when two members share a key or mix key kinds. It adds analyzer and run-time tests for types marked SuppressSourceGeneration, plus a README section.

decisions.title: Dependency change in Directory.Packages.props
decisions.oneliner: Dependency and toolchain versions decide which users can build and run the package.
decisions.question: Accept this dependency or toolchain change?
decisions.routed_by: policy rule 'dependency': the reviewer may not decide this

decisions.title: Fix never touches SuppressSourceGeneration handling
decisions.oneliner: Only duplicate-key crash guards changed; nothing shows why suppressed types stopped being analyzed in 3.1.1.
decisions.requirement_part: The analyzer does not work if SuppressSourceGeneration = true
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: The 3.1.1 regression was solely an ArgumentException from duplicate keys, and the MsgPack004/015/003 tests fail on the old code.
decisions.question: Has anyone confirmed the new MsgPack004/015/003 suppressed-type tests fail without this change?

decisions.title: `continue` skips the rest of the member's checks
decisions.oneliner: Members with mismatched key kinds now skip formatter-attribute handling and any later member-type collection. This also applies to generated types.
quote: continue; // The key kind does not match the other members; the diagnostic is reported, so skip this member.
decisions.would_be_wrong_if: Nothing after the key-registration block in the loop body reports diagnostics or collects nested types.
decisions.question: Is it acceptable that a mixed-key member no longer gets its member type validated (MsgPack003)?

handled.title: Duplicate keys silently keep the first member
handled.oneliner: The second member with the same key is dropped from the model. This relies on MsgPack005 being reported elsewhere, which is not in this diff.
handled.would_be_wrong_if: The duplicate-key diagnostic is emitted before this point in code not shown.
handled.routed_by: low impact or no decision needed

handled.title: Execution tests don't exercise the analyzer
handled.oneliner: The round-trip test and the null-formatter test check run-time behavior that existed before. They prove nothing about the analyzer bug.
handled.routed_by: low impact or no decision needed

dropped.title: README claims a check that no test covers
dropped.dropped_because: quote not found in diff: ['Types are accessible to the resolver ([MsgPack012](doc/analyzers/MsgPack012.md)).']
